description.zh: 阶段签核制全栈开发数字员工：需求理解 → 计划设计（Gate A）→ 开发 · 单测（Gate B）→ 交付闭环 → 记忆沉淀（Gate C），每道关口人工确认；git worktree 隔离开发，提交物链全程留痕。
description.en: Sign-off gated full-stack dev agent: understand → design (Gate A) → code & test (Gate B) → delivery → knowledge capture (Gate C), each gate confirmed by you; develops in git worktrees with a full artifact chain.

welcome_message.zh: 描述你的开发需求，我按签核制流程推进：理解 → 设计 → Gate A → 编码 → 测试 → Gate B → 交付。首次使用请准备 git 仓库地址与访问凭证。
welcome_message.en: Describe your dev task — I'll drive the sign-off flow: understand → design → Gate A → code → test → Gate B → deliver. First time? Have your git repo URL and credentials ready.

description.zh: 从理解阶段开始：澄清需求 → 产出 spec/plan → 等你 Gate A 点头才编码
description.en: Start from understanding: clarify → spec/plan → waits for your Gate A approval before coding

prompt.zh:
我有一个新需求：

<在这里描述需求>

请按数字员工流程从理解阶段开始，先给 intent 草稿等我校对。
prompt.en:
I have a new feature request:

<describe here>

Start the digital-employee flow from the understanding phase; show me the intent draft first.

description.zh: 缺陷流程：复现 → 先写失败测试 → 修复 → 回归对比 → 交付
description.en: Bug flow: reproduce → failing test first → fix → regression compare → deliver

prompt.zh:
我发现一个问题：

<现象与复现步骤>

请按缺陷流程处理：先复现定位，写失败测试确认，再修复。
prompt.en:
I found an issue:

<symptoms & repro steps>

Follow the bug flow: reproduce, write a failing test, then fix.

description.zh: 提供仓库地址与凭证，clone 到工作区并初始化工程约定
description.en: Give repo URL & credentials; I'll clone and initialize project conventions

prompt.zh: 请初始化开发环境。仓库地址：<URL>。我的 git 用户名：<用户名>，访问凭证（token）：<token>。clone 后学习工程约定并准备就绪。
prompt.en: Initialize the dev environment. Repo: <URL>. Git username: <username>, token: <token>. Clone it, learn the project conventions, and get ready.

description.zh: 汇总知识卡 → 提炼高频规则 → 建议升级工程约定（Gate C 确认后落盘）
description.en: Aggregate knowledge cards → distill rules → propose convention updates (Gate C before write)

prompt.zh: 对本工程做一次知识沉淀与模式提炼：汇总已有知识卡，提炼高频规则，给出工程约定升级建议草稿等我确认。
prompt.en: Run a knowledge capture on this project: aggregate cards, distill recurring rules, draft convention updates for my approval.
